title: Pots and the sleeping dog
subtitle: Tap to jump. Hold for higher.

sections.name: Yard
sections.note: The neighbour naps on his cot; hens peck about; hold to lift the basket.

sections.name: FirstPot
sections.note: One pot stack alone: the rooster hops it, mangoes trace the jump.

sections.name: TwoPots
sections.note: Two pot stacks 7 m apart: jump, land, jump.

sections.name: Dung
sections.note: Cow dung: low, a tap clears it; miss it and she slips.

sections.name: SleepingDog
sections.note: The sleeping dog: long, so hold the jump. A feather above for a double jump.

sections.name: Breather
sections.note: Room to breathe: a wave of mangoes and the first chilli.

sections.name: HandPump
sections.note: The hand-pump puddle: wide and low, only a held jump clears it.

sections.name: Cart
sections.note: The bullock cart: jump onto its bed, run off the end. A feather for a double jump.

sections.name: PotsDungPots
sections.note: Pots, dung, pots: 6.5 m apart, the first rhythm.

sections.name: DogPots
sections.note: The dog, then a pot stack.

sections.name: Lane
sections.note: A short run of mangoes.

sections.name: PotTrio
sections.note: Three pot stacks in rhythm; a feather at the top of a double jump over the middle.

sections.name: PuddleDog
sections.note: The puddle, then the dog.

sections.name: CartPots
sections.note: The cart as a step: off its bed straight into a jump over pots.

sections.name: ChilliStraight
sections.note: A long straight and a chilli to win back ground.

sections.name: DungPair
sections.note: Two cow pats: tap, tap.

sections.name: Mischief
sections.note: The puddle; then the rooster knocks a pot stack off its stand into the lane.

sections.name: DogDung
sections.note: The dog and the dung.

sections.name: ChilliLane
sections.note: A breather and a chilli.

sections.name: PotQuartet
sections.note: Four pot stacks, 6.5 m apart.

sections.name: LastCart
sections.note: The last cart, and pots after it.

sections.name: DogDungPots
sections.note: Dog, dung, pots.

sections.name: FinalChilli
sections.note: The last chilli.

sections.name: PuddlePots
sections.note: The puddle and two pots: the last test.

sections.name: OpenLane
sections.note: The lane opens out: if he is still ahead, he gets away at 500 m.
